description: Hash a password with bcrypt or argon2id, or verify a hash. Returns an htpasswd line when a username is set. The password is not stored or logged. The page in the browser never sends the password; this call only hashes the arguments you send.

hash.description: Existing bcrypt or argon2id hash. When set, the password is verified instead of hashed.

password.description: Password to hash or verify. It is used only for this call and is not stored.

username.description: Optional htpasswd username. A colon is not allowed.

name: hash_password
title: Hash or verify a password
